occasion: owner reaction to round-1 elicitation questions
text: On the first live run (room-booking) the Business Analyst asked 15 detailed questions, several multi-part, citing legislation and acronyms. The owner's reaction: "I don't understand the point of these questions." Agreed fix, owner-approved: ask at most about five questions, only those that would really change the result; each one plain sentence with its default alongside; quietly assume everything else and list those assumptions for the owner to check.
